text: Unimpeded means with nothing in the way. In the article it describes neutrinos, which barely interact with matter, so they can cross vast distances without being stopped and still point back to where they came from.

To refute a claim is to prove it wrong with evidence, which is stronger than merely denying it. Dr Kagan refuted the assumption that a reaction could never beat the imbalance of its catalyst by showing that it could.

Bullish means confidently optimistic about how things will turn out, a word borrowed from finance, where rising markets are called bull markets. The medicine laureates can point to real benefits of their work, so they are allowed more bullishness than the physicist.
A laureate is someone honoured with a major prize, here a Nobel. The word comes from the laurel wreath that ancient Greeks and Romans gave to winners.
To share the stage is to appear alongside others rather than alone. Most physics Nobels are split among collaborators, so Dr Halzen standing alone is unusual.
An undivided spotlight means all the attention goes to one person. Dr Halzen is the only physics winner this year, so no one shares the credit.
A citation is an official statement of the reasons for an honour. The Nobel citation names exactly which contributions the prize rewards.
To unveil something is to reveal it publicly for the first time; it literally means removing a veil. Here the prize announcement was unveiled on Tuesday.

Neutrinos are extremely light particles with no electric charge that pass through nearly everything, including your body, without any effect. Trillions pass through you every second, mostly from the Sun.
IceCube is a detector built into a cubic kilometre of Antarctic ice. Rare flashes of light inside the ice reveal when a neutrino has struck an atom.
In spades means in large measure. The phrase comes from card games, where spades can be the highest suit.
Diminutive means very small. In the article the physicists joke that neutrinos get their name from being neutral and tiny, with -ino being an Italian ending for something little.
Immune normally means protected from a disease, but here it means unaffected by something. Neutrinos feel neither electromagnetism nor gravity in any noticeable way, so most detectors miss them.
In effect means for practical purposes, even if not literally. The article says neutrinos are in effect immune to those two forces.
The weak nuclear force is one of nature's four fundamental forces. It acts only at tiny distances and is the one neutrinos interact through, which is why they so rarely react with anything.
Aptly means in a way that fits well. The weak force is aptly named because its effects really are feeble.
Fission is splitting a heavy atom into lighter pieces, releasing energy. Nuclear power stations use it, and it also emits neutrinos.
Fusion is joining light atoms into a heavier one, releasing energy. It powers the Sun and produces the solar neutrinos mentioned here.
A by-product is something produced along the way while making something else. Neutrinos are a by-product of fission and fusion.
Protons are positively charged particles found in every atom's nucleus. Because they are charged, magnetic fields bend their paths, which hides where they came from.
Deflected means turned aside from a straight path. Magnetic fields deflect charged protons on the way to Earth, so their origin is hard to trace.
A magnetic field is the region around a magnet or moving charge where magnetic forces act. They steer charged particles but have no effect on neutral neutrinos.
To reconstruct is to work out how something happened or where something started from the evidence left behind. Here, scientists try to reconstruct a proton's origin from its track.
A vat is a large tank for holding liquid. Earlier neutrino detectors were vats of cleaning fluid.
Perchloroethylene is a chemical solvent used in dry cleaning. Early detectors used large tanks of it, hoping a neutrino would occasionally change one of its atoms.
Extrasolar means from outside our solar system. Extrasolar neutrinos are the ones that come from far beyond the Sun.
To crystallise is to take clear, definite shape, like a crystal forming from a liquid. The idea for IceCube took shape in this way.
The cosmos means the universe seen as an ordered whole.
Physiology is the study of how living things work. Together with medicine it forms one of the Nobel categories.
Optogenetics is a technique that makes selected brain cells respond to light by giving them a gene for a light-sensitive protein. Researchers can then switch those cells on with a flash.
Neurons are the nerve cells that carry electrical signals through the brain and body.
A genus is a group of closely related species. Chlamydomonas is a genus of single-celled algae.
Algae are simple plant-like organisms that live in water and get energy from light. The ones in this story are tiny, single cells.
An ion channel is a protein that forms a pore in a cell's surface and opens to let charged atoms pass, creating an electrical signal.
Convoluted means twisting and complicated. In the human eye detecting light takes two proteins in sequence, whereas the algae seemed to do it in one step.
Blossoming means growing and developing quickly, like a flower opening.
Genomics is the study of whole sets of genes. Mapping the algae's DNA let researchers spot candidate genes quickly.
A French phrase meaning reason for existing. The cells whose raison d’être is carrying electrical signals are neurons.
Channelrhodopsin-2 is the algal protein that opens when light hits it. Putting it in neurons lets light switch them on.
Miffed means mildly annoyed or put out. The article suggests Dr Miesenböck might have good reason to feel overlooked.
An omission is something left out. A surprising omission means a person many would have expected on the list is missing.
Here priority means who came first with a discovery, which matters for credit. Regardless of details of priority means setting aside who did it first.

t: Great oaks from little acorns grow
forms: Great oaks from little acorns grow
text: A proverb meaning that big things begin small. Here the big field of optogenetics began with tiny algae.
Retinitis pigmentosa is an inherited eye disease in which the light-detecting cells of the retina gradually die, causing blindness.
A chiral molecule has a mirror-image twin that cannot be rotated to match it, just as your left and right hands are mirror images. Chirality is this handedness.
A catalyst is a substance that speeds up a chemical reaction without being used up.
Ruthlessly means without mercy or compromise. The article says nature ruthlessly picks one hand of each molecule.
Asymmetry is a lack of balance between two sides. Here it means unequal amounts of left- and right-handed molecules.
Inanimate means not alive, like rocks and chemicals.
Self-amplification is when a small effect makes itself bigger. In Dr Soai’s reaction, a small imbalance produced a catalyst that created a much larger one.
Reagents are the chemicals used to carry out a reaction.
The very beginning of life on Earth, billions of years ago.
